framing.what_it_is: A transparent, self-built INTEREST CHECK grounded in the Holland/RIASEC vocational model.
framing.what_it_is_not: NOT the O*NET Interest Profiler and NOT any validated or official instrument. It sketches which kinds of activities the person leans toward; it does not diagnose, label, or predict hiring.
framing.honesty_line_en: This is a quick interest check, not an official test. It's built on the Holland/RIASEC model — a real, widely-used vocational framework — but it is NOT the O*NET Interest Profiler or any validated instrument. It just sketches which kinds of activities you lean toward. Answer for what you'd ENJOY, not what you're good at or 'should' like.
framing.honesty_line_zh: 这是一个快速的兴趣小测，不是正式测评。它基于真实、常用的 Holland/RIASEC 职业兴趣模型，但并不是 O*NET Interest Profiler，也不是任何经过验证的正式量表。它只是勾勒你更偏好哪类活动。请按你会「喜欢」什么来回答，而不是你擅长什么或「应该」喜欢什么。

response_scale.presentation: Present each item as one AskUserQuestion with these selectable options — never free-text.

interest_items.en: Build, assemble, or repair something with my hands or with tools.
interest_items.zh: 用手或工具搭建、组装或修理东西。

interest_items.en: Work outdoors with plants, animals, machines, or the land.
interest_items.zh: 在户外和植物、动物、机器或土地打交道。

interest_items.en: Operate equipment or vehicles, or fix mechanical/electrical things.
interest_items.zh: 操作设备或车辆，或修理机械/电气类的东西。

interest_items.en: Take apart how something works and put it back together better.
interest_items.zh: 拆开研究一样东西怎么运转，再把它更好地装回去。

interest_items.en: Investigate a puzzling question by gathering and analyzing data.
interest_items.zh: 通过收集和分析数据去研究一个让人费解的问题。

interest_items.en: Read or run experiments to understand why something happens.
interest_items.zh: 通过阅读或做实验去理解某件事为什么会发生。

interest_items.en: Work through a hard technical or scientific problem on my own.
interest_items.zh: 独自钻研一个困难的技术或科学问题。

interest_items.en: Learn a complex system deeply just to satisfy my curiosity.
interest_items.zh: 纯粹出于好奇，深入弄懂一个复杂系统。

interest_items.en: Create original work — writing, music, design, art, or performance.
interest_items.zh: 创作原创作品——写作、音乐、设计、艺术或表演。

interest_items.en: Come up with unconventional ideas and express them my own way.
interest_items.zh: 想出不落俗套的点子，并用自己的方式表达出来。

interest_items.en: Work in an open-ended space with few fixed rules or procedures.
interest_items.zh: 在少有固定规则或流程、开放度高的环境里工作。

interest_items.en: Design how something looks, sounds, or reads so it moves people.
interest_items.zh: 设计一样东西的外观、声音或文字，让它打动人。

interest_items.en: Teach, coach, or explain something to help someone grow.
interest_items.zh: 教学、指导或讲解，帮助别人成长。

interest_items.en: Listen to and support people through a personal or practical problem.
interest_items.zh: 倾听并陪伴他人度过一个个人或现实的难题。

interest_items.en: Work closely as part of a team focused on others' wellbeing.
interest_items.zh: 作为团队一员，紧密协作去关照他人的福祉。

interest_items.en: Persuade, pitch, or lead others toward a goal or a sale.
interest_items.zh: 说服、推介或带领别人达成一个目标或一笔成交。

interest_items.en: Start or run a venture and take responsibility for the outcome.
interest_items.zh: 创办或经营一项事业，并为结果负责。

interest_items.en: Negotiate, influence a decision, or take charge of a group.
interest_items.zh: 谈判、影响一个决定，或主导一个团队。

interest_items.en: Organize records, schedules, or data so everything is accurate.
interest_items.zh: 整理记录、日程或数据，让一切都准确无误。

interest_items.en: Follow a clear, well-defined procedure and get the details exactly right.
interest_items.zh: 按清晰、明确的流程，把每个细节做到分毫不差。

interest_items.en: Manage numbers, budgets, or files in a structured, orderly way.
interest_items.zh: 以有条理、有秩序的方式管理数字、预算或档案。

scoring_key_note: R, I, and A carry 4 items each; S, E, and C carry 3 each (total 21). (Input design prose said 'R and I have 4, A/S/E/C have 3' — that miscounted A, which has 4 items per the key. Normalization below uses each type's ACTUAL item count, so the uneven counts never bias the vector.)
normalization: Per-type raw score = sum of that type's item responses (each 0-4). Normalize each type to 0-1 by dividing by (n_items_for_type * 4). This yields the person interest vector [R,I,A,S,E,C] fed to career_match.py.

short_form.rule: A 12-item subset (2 items per type) is a valid run; the confidence note shrinks accordingly and MUST be surfaced. Item ids are pre-tagged so any subset still maps via scoring_key.
short_form.balanced_24: An optional balanced 24-item set adds one more S/E/C item each (4 per type); items stay pre-tagged so the key generalizes.

optional_big_five.framing_en: A light read from well-known trait descriptions — a mirror to react to, not a scored personality test. No percentile, no label.
optional_big_five.framing_zh: 从大家熟悉的人格特质描述里做一次轻量对照——是给你照的一面镜子，不是打分的人格测验。不给百分位，不贴标签。

traits.low_pole_en: Practical, conventional, prefers the familiar and concrete
traits.high_pole_en: Curious, imaginative, drawn to novelty, ideas, and variety

traits.low_pole_en: Flexible, spontaneous, loose with plans and deadlines
traits.high_pole_en: Organized, dependable, plans ahead, follows through

traits.low_pole_en: Reserved, energized by solitude and depth
traits.high_pole_en: Outgoing, energized by people and high activity

traits.low_pole_en: Frank, competitive, skeptical, puts task over harmony
Sensitive to stress, feels pressure and setbacks keenly
traits.high_pole_en: Calm, even, recovers quickly under pressure

optional_big_five.usage: Qualitative + a SMALL soft trait-fit signal only (see scoring spec). Never reported as a percentile or a personality label.

optional_work_values.framing_en: Rank these six by how much they matter to you at work — forced-choice, so trade-offs are real.
optional_work_values.framing_zh: 按它们对你工作的重要程度，给这六项排序——强制取舍，所以权衡是真实的。

values.en: Using my abilities, seeing concrete results, a sense of accomplishment
Autonomy — deciding my own methods, working with little supervision
Advancement, status, being respected and looked up to
Friendly co-workers, service to others, no ethical conflict
Supportive management, fair and consistent treatment, good backing
Security, pay, comfort, variety, good conditions

optional_work_values.ipsative_to_weights: A rank r in {1..6} maps to score (7 - r), giving 6,5,4,3,2,1; divide by 21 (=6+5+...+1) so the values vector sums to 1. This is a PREFERENCE vector, not a Likert level — no absolute magnitudes are invented.
